Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Serco repurchased 1,776,229 ordinary shares between 9–13 November 2026 under its buyback programme at daily average prices of 284.7683p (09 Nov), 290.0210p (10 Nov), 288.4800p (11 Nov), 290.0843p (12 Nov) and 283.8840p (13 Nov). Since the Programme announcement on 11 August 2026 the Company has acquired 19,433,614 shares held in treasury (approximately 1.94% of issued share capital), leaving 954,861,935 Ordinary Shares in issue excluding 47,884,079 treasury shares; total voting rights are 954,861,935. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 13 November 2026 13 November 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (“ Ordinary Shares ”) through RBC Europe Limited. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
